data.name: Bloodthirst Stain
data.description: Your toothy maw distorts your speech, and your thoughts flit between potential prey. You take a 15%% spell failure chance for spells with verbal or thought (Occult Adventures 144) components and a -2 penalty on all Bluff, Diplomacy, Disguise, Handle Animal, and Perform checks.
